About

People first.
Designer second.

I’m a product and visual design leader, builder, dad, coach, furniture maker, coffee nerd and film obsessive based in Madison, Wisconsin.

Who I am

We’re all people before we’re employees. I believe knowing where someone comes from, what motivates them and what they care about outside work makes collaboration stronger.

I’m a proud Midwesterner and a dad to three active kids. Outside the office you’ll usually find me coaching, building furniture in my workshop, obsessing over coffee, snowboarding, running, traveling with my family or analyzing the cinematography of a movie nobody else asked me to analyze.

At work

I’ve spent more than 15 years moving between product strategy and hands-on visual craft across startups and large organizations. My experience spans zero-to-one products, visual and design systems, creative direction, motion, privacy, ads, commerce, live shopping and B2B tools.

I spent more than three years at Meta working on Responsibility & Privacy for Facebook and Instagram, launching global controls and commerce experiences. Today I lead product design at RetailMeNot, helping shape the next generation of savings and shopping experiences.
